translate_layer_name: translate a user-friendly layer name like 'mid' or 'down.block_0.0' into the actual UNet module path
expand_lora_scales: expand a list of LoRA weight scales into a granular per-layer dictionary for a UNet2DConditionModel
expand_lora_scales_per_adapter: expand LoRA weight scales for a single adapter into per-block and per-attention-layer scale values
validate_lora_scale_layers: validate that specified LoRA scale layers exist in the UNet state dict before applying them
build_lora_scale_config: build a per-layer LoRA scale configuration from coarse block-level or global scale specifications
